walkthroughs.body_html: Norway HDI 0.961 (1st); Niger 0.394 (last). GDP per capita ratio: USA $80000 vs Burundi $260, a 300x gap. Oxfam (2023): richest 1 percent took two-thirds of new wealth created since 2020.

Antarctic Treaty (1959) prohibits military use and mineral extraction. UNCLOS (1982) covers ocean floor; deep-sea mining negotiations ongoing. Atmosphere governed via UNFCCC since 1992 with limited enforcement.

Antarctica covers 14 million km^2 (1.5x Europe). Madrid Protocol (1991) extends Antarctic Treaty: mining ban until 2048 review. Tourism reached 105000 visitors in 2022/23 season, raising environmental concerns.

mcqs.q: Why is HDI a better measure of development than GNI per capita?
options: Because HDI measures how happy people are.
HDI combines income, life expectancy and education, capturing quality of life — GNI per capita is just average income and hides inequality and non-economic wellbeing.
Because HDI is easier to calculate than GNI.
GDP is for the government and GNI is for individuals.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between GDP and GNI?
options: GDP measures all economic activity within a country's borders; GNI adds income from citizens and companies abroad and subtracts income earned by foreigners inside — capturing national income flows.
GDP is for the government and GNI is for individuals.
GDP and GNI are the same — just measured by different organisations.

mcqs.q: Why is the Brandt Line considered outdated?
options: Drawn in 1980, it predates the rise of NICs (China, India, Brazil) and globalisation — countries like South Korea, Singapore and Chile no longer fit neatly on the 'poor south' side.
The Brandt Line is the boundary between the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.
GDP is for the government and GNI is for individuals.
The Brandt Line still accurately divides rich and poor countries today.
